sweeps.flat_rationale: Under normal offered query load, the dynamic MIMD controller operates within its active adaptive range (U in [2, 20]), so the emergency ceiling U_max is rarely saturated, resulting in robust stability with delta AP < 0.005 across the perturbation range.

factorial_decomposition.interpretation: The interaction synergy is tiny (I = -0.000829, |I| < 0.001), confirming that feature memory adaptation and publication cadence throttling operate orthogonally. The 66.98% write savings of dynamic MIMD carry over cleanly to adaptive alpha regimes.
